address: Town Hall Sukhumvit 49, Khlong Tan Nuea, Vadhana, Bangkok, 10110, Thailand
bio: Driven by the chef’s desire to put an original twist on Korean recipes, this restaurant delivers well-known cuisine through a creative lens. The flavours and combinations may be long established, but they’re presented with original touches – such as a painting-like uni bibimbap that will make you see the dish in a completely new light. A few flavour innovations can also be found, such as strawberry doenjang. The contemporary reinvention of classic cooking is reflected in the combination of chic décor and traditional Korean furniture....
